summary: Graf Global Corp. (a SPAC) filed an 8-K/A amending its original 8-K to disclose entry into a Business Combination Agreement with BIG3 HoldCo LLC and related entities. The de-SPAC transaction involves Graf domesticating from Cayman Islands to Delaware, then a reverse merger where SPAC Merger Sub merges into Graf, making Graf a wholly-owned subsidiary of Pubco (Halfcourt Holdco, Inc.). No per-share price, premium, or stake percentages are stated in the excerpt. The board's recommendation is not explicitly noted. The closing is subject to customary conditions including SEC and shareholder approvals. Key watch: risk-arb spread on SPAC merger completion and any redemption pressure.
